---
title: "AutoGridFR (AGFR)"
---

AutoGridFR prepares a receptor for docking with AutoDockFR, AutoDock CrankPep and AutoDock4. It sets up the docking box, finds binding pockets with AutoSite, computes affinity maps with AutoGrid4 and saves them in a single target file (.trg). It supports flexible side chains, covalent docking and water maps for hydrated docking.
